Bill.BriefDescription: Repealing provisions concerning animal massage practitioners.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to animal massage practitioners; amending RCW18.108.010; repealing RCW 18.108.230; and repealing 2001 c 297 s 1(uncodified).
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.108.010 and 2002 c 277 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, thefollowing meanings shall apply: (1) "Board" means the Washington state board of massage. (2) "Massage" and "massage therapy" mean a health care serviceinvolving the external manipulation or pressure of soft tissue of thehuman body for therapeutic purposes. Massage therapy includestechniques such as tapping, compressions, friction, Swedish gymnasticsor movements, gliding, kneading, shaking, and fascial or connectivetissue stretching, with or without the aids of superficial heat, cold,water, lubricants, or salts. Massage therapy does not includediagnosis or attempts to adjust or manipulate any articulations of thebody or spine or mobilization of these articulations by the use of athrusting force, nor does it include genital manipulation. p. 1 HB 2092 (3) "Massage practitioner" means an individual licensed under thischapter. (4) "Secretary" means the secretary of health or the secretary'sdesignee. (5) "Massage business" means the operation of a business wheremassages are given. (((6) "Animal massage practitioner" means an individual with alicense to practice massage therapy in this state with additionaltraining in animal therapy.))
The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 18.108.230 (Animal massage practitionerEndorsementTraining requirementsRules) and 2001 c 297 s 3; and 2001 c 297 s 1 (uncodified).
